newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Shares dip, Genbel busiest.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Shares dip, Genbel busiest.

text.p: The Namibian Stock Exchange Overall Index dipped last week with trade led by Investment trust Genbel South Africa.
A total of 255,200 Genbel shares traded while the price fluctuated around N$16.85 per share.
Engen saw new buying interest, reaching N$27.20 per share by the close of trade on Friday. Pep Namibia was also actively traded with a total of 100,900 shares chaning hands.
Namibian Fishing Industries traded 12,000 shares as it reached a low of 60 cents a share on Friday.
A total of 544,100 shares worth N$8.4 million traded during the week and the NSE overall index dipped to 239.26 from the previous week's 241.86.
The NSE local index reached 151.59 compared with 146.97 a week ago, helped along by firmer prices in Namco and ODM.
